title: Hengliyuan Sweetener Blend Cost Calculator
description: Estimate blend cost, loss, bulk cartons, editable USD comparison and reference sweetness without uploading a formula.
features: Editable ingredient rows, dated CNY EXW reference prices, proportional loss and process choice.
Round-up 25 kg bulk cartons, CNY/USD comparison and a customer-editable exchange rate.
Customer-selected sweetness values within published ranges, custom ingredients and a copyable estimate.
limit: Indicative EXW references, not a quotation or approved recipe. Retail filling and retail packaging, freight, insurance, duties and taxes are excluded. Sensory validation is required.
